activities.instructions: Ayuda a la rana a cruzar el río eligiendo el nenúfar correcto en cada salto.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: The timetable reduced delays on two routes during its first month. [gap1] The team plans to monitor other routes before recommending a wider change.

options.text: The timetable was cancelled before testing.
This encouraging result is too narrow to establish a network-wide effect.
The network was never measured.

rounds.explanation: The first-month, two-route evidence explains the cautious next step.

rounds.prompt: The council published responses and its analytical method alongside the summary. [gap1] This made it possible to distinguish evidence from interpretation.

options.text: Readers could examine both the original material and the process used.
The responses were destroyed after publication.
The summary contained no conclusions.

rounds.explanation: Access to the data and method explains how readers can separate evidence from interpretation.

rounds.prompt: The pilot attracted many volunteers but demanded more coordination than expected. [gap1] The organisers therefore revised the registration process.

options.text: Several people had registered through different channels.
The volunteers preferred blue badges.
The pilot took place beside a river.

rounds.explanation: Different registration channels explain the coordination problem and revision.

rounds.prompt: The policy increased recycling where collection points were clearly visible. [gap1] In buildings where bins were hidden, the effect was negligible.

options.text: The policy was announced in winter.
Some bins were made of metal.
The results consequently depended on how the policy was implemented.

rounds.explanation: The second sentence gives a contrasting implementation condition, so the gap should draw that conclusion.

rounds.prompt: The report presents two possible designs. [gap1] The other is cheaper initially but may need more repairs.

options.text: The building has a wide entrance.
The report was printed in two colours.
The first uses stronger materials and costs more to build.

rounds.explanation: The first design must be introduced before the second is contrasted with it.

rounds.prompt: The app's users reported saving time. [gap1] The authors recommend an independent trial before estimating the size of the benefit.

options.text: The trial was already independent.
Those reports were based on personal estimates rather than timed tasks.
The app has a bright icon.

rounds.explanation: The measurement limitation motivates the recommendation for an independent trial.

rounds.prompt: The course attracted more applicants after an evening option was added. [gap1] Attendance, however, remained steady.

options.text: The course had no application form.
The increase therefore shows interest rather than a proven completion benefit.
The classrooms were painted white.

rounds.explanation: The missing sentence interprets increased applications while the next sentence limits the conclusion.

rounds.prompt: The scheme reduced waste in the catering department. [gap1] Other departments are now considering whether the same approach would work for them.

options.text: The bins were painted last year.
The team ordered smaller quantities more frequently.
Several visitors asked for directions.

rounds.explanation: The sentence gives a concrete example of the waste-reduction approach.

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.

activities.instructions: Colócate en el carril de la respuesta correcta antes de cruzar cada puerta.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: The shared office reduced rent and encouraged informal contact. [gap1] Workers nevertheless reported fewer quiet periods for demanding tasks.

options.text: The office had no shared equipment.
The financial saving was therefore accompanied by a working-condition cost.
The rent increased after one month.

rounds.explanation: The missing sentence summarises the benefit and prepares the later limitation.

rounds.prompt: The room was used before presentations and complex negotiations. [gap1] Routine email, by contrast, was usually handled at shared desks.

options.text: These demanding tasks required a quiet space for preparation.
The building opened in April.
The desks were made of light wood.

rounds.explanation: These demanding tasks refers to presentations and negotiations and explains the room's use.

rounds.prompt: The new timetable reduced delays on two routes. [gap1] The team has not yet examined the rest of the network.

options.text: The station opened many years ago.
Nevertheless, the result cannot yet support a network-wide claim.
For example, one route has a blue sign.

rounds.explanation: Nevertheless introduces the limitation that the positive result is narrow.

rounds.prompt: The first design has a lower purchase price. [gap1] The committee later selected the second after reviewing ten-year maintenance costs.

options.text: The alternative uses more durable materials.
The room was quiet during the meeting.
The committee printed the plans twice.

rounds.explanation: The durable alternative must be introduced before the later decision is explained.

rounds.prompt: The first design was cheaper to purchase. [gap1] The committee selected the second after considering costs over ten years.

options.text: Both designs were discarded immediately.
The committee did not discuss maintenance.
The second was more durable and expected to require fewer repairs.

rounds.explanation: Durability and fewer repairs explain why long-term costs changed the decision.

rounds.prompt: The mentoring trial improved attendance among participants who completed the first month. [gap1] The report avoids extending the result to all students.

options.text: It was unclear whether the most absent students had joined.
Attendance fell across the school.
The trial included no participants.

rounds.explanation: Unknown participation explains why the result cannot be generalised.

rounds.prompt: The new office layout reduced private rooms. [gap1] Staff reported that informal questions were easier to resolve.

options.text: It also placed project teams closer together.
The project ended in January.
The old building was made of stone.

rounds.explanation: Closer teams explain why informal questions became easier despite fewer private rooms.

rounds.prompt: The policy worked in offices with visible collection points but had little effect where bins were hidden. [gap1] The recommendation therefore focuses on design as well as rules.

options.text: The contrast suggests that implementation shaped behaviour.
The offices all used identical furniture.
The policy was printed in large letters.

rounds.explanation: The difference between visible and hidden bins supports the implementation inference.

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.

activities.instructions: Apila los fragmentos en orden para levantar la frase.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: The archive began digitising its photographs in stages. [gap1] This allowed staff to correct labels before adding more files.

options.text: The photographs show several rivers.
The first stage was deliberately kept small.
The building has a new entrance.

rounds.explanation: A small first stage explains how staff could check labels before expansion.

rounds.prompt: The council published the raw responses as well as its survey summary. [gap1] Residents could therefore inspect how the final claims had been formed.

options.text: Residents were not invited to read it.
The council had three offices.
It also described the method used to analyse them.

rounds.explanation: The method is necessary for readers to understand how claims came from responses.

rounds.prompt: The audio-guide ratings were high. [gap1] The authors therefore avoid claiming that every visitor would value the guide equally.

options.text: The recordings were short.
Only visitors who chose to borrow it completed the evaluation.
The guide used three languages.

rounds.explanation: The self-selected sample explains the cautious conclusion.

rounds.prompt: The pilot attracted strong interest but demanded more staff time than predicted. [gap1] The organisers will continue it while redesigning registration.

options.text: The pilot has ended permanently.
No one wanted to participate.
The value of the idea is therefore clear, even though its process needs work.

rounds.explanation: The gap balances demand with the administrative weakness before the continuation decision.

rounds.prompt: The rooftop garden lowered the building's summer temperature slightly. [gap1] The organisers are monitoring water use before expanding it.

options.text: The building has a basement.
That modest result is encouraging but not sufficient on its own.
The roof was repaired before the trial.

rounds.explanation: The sentence evaluates the small result and prepares the need for monitoring.

rounds.prompt: The council introduced a shared shuttle for villages outside the town. [gap1] Older residents could reach the clinic without arranging a lift.

options.text: Most villages have narrow gardens.
The town owns several bicycles.
The route was designed around the most regular essential journeys.

rounds.explanation: The route design explains how the shuttle produced the benefit in the following sentence.

rounds.prompt: The first survey suggested strong support for the redesign. [gap1] The authors recommended a broader consultation before drawing a firm conclusion.

options.text: The council met in the afternoon.
Residents use the square in summer.
Most responses came from people who attended the public meeting.

rounds.explanation: The limited respondent group explains the recommendation for broader consultation.

rounds.prompt: The report begins by describing a fall in local shop numbers. [gap1] It then explains why a weekly market has brought some customers back.

options.text: The opening establishes the problem that the later example partially addresses.
The shops are painted different colours.
The report was written by a resident.

rounds.explanation: The gap should explain the role of the opening before the text moves to partial recovery.

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.
